specNote: Simplified, hand-built SBOM — direct dependencies only. A full CycloneDX/SPDX document with the resolved transitive tree should be generated by `cyclonedx-py` (or `pip-audit --format=cyclonedx-json`) inside a build environment that has package-registry access, and regenerated on every dependency change as part of the software-factory pipeline.
standardLibraryOnly: auth.py uses only stdlib (hashlib, hmac, base64, struct, secrets, json) for password hashing, JWT, and TOTP MFA — no third-party crypto dependency to track
